     message and does nothing when you
     tap it.
  2. Phone toast only
     A tap on the toast at the top of
     the phone page opens the space
     directly on the phone.
  3. Both notices
     A tap on either notice opens the
     space on the device where you
     tapped it.
  4. Neither notice
     Both notices only tell you that
     something changed.
  5. Type something.
